newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa ends at highs on NY strength.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa ends at highs on NY strength.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa futures ended at highs, helped up by arbitrage buying against a firming New York, traders said.
Active March last traded 26 stg up, at 857 stg, while May last traded 23 stg up at 879 stg.
March traded 2,062 lots, followed closely by May with 2,028. Total volume was 6,664 lots.
But trade had been inflated by switches. "The actual outright volume is minimal today, I'd say," one trader said.
He cited New York's strength as the main factor behind London's rise. "Cable has lost a cent and you're getting arbitrage buying in London and selling in New York."
There were signs of short covering to help London up, he said.
